detector.capability_check_blindness: A capability-superset check passes on fx-two-scheduler because both planes are present and working. Duplicate control planes are not capability loss.
detector.failure_class: workflow fusion creates duplicate control planes
detector.fire_condition: Either signal reports n_schedulers != 1 or n_state_stores != 1 or n_execution_order_owners != 1 (static) / n_scheduler_processes != 1 or n_state_write_targets != 1 (runtime).
detector.rule: A fused workflow may own exactly one scheduler, exactly one state store, and exactly one execution-order owner. A second plane fails the fusion even when both planes work and even when two stores are consistent. A parallel helper is not a control plane.

signals.mechanism: Census distinct scheduler, state_store, and execution_order_owner identities on the fused IR declared section and component roles. Does not read runtime_script.
Replay runtime_script: processes that emit run_loop/schedule_step/dispatch_order are scheduler processes; commit_state targets are state-write targets. Helper ops never promote a process.

detector.silence_condition: Both signals report exactly one scheduler plane and exactly one state-write plane; helper processes are ignored.

evidence.claim: static_census counts declared/component schedulers, state stores, and execution-order owners; helpers excluded; two consistent stores still fail singularity.
runtime_observe replays runtime_script independently of declared counts; fx-declare-one-spawn-two is silent on A and fires on B.
